qualified_environment.worker_cpu_affinity: one actually available CPU, recorded per launch
qualified_environment.slepc_route: not used by direct diagnostic; matching complex/int64 SLEPc not available in this ABI and known system SLEPc import registration fails

solver_settings.normal_correction_policy: one configured solver-normal correction; use this output before the extra diagnostic correction for q/R comparisons

A1_R10.source_identity_scope: 41 solve-recorded numerical source files match current hashes; this is the explicit source list, not the entire transitive dependency closure

A2_Y6_1.identity_gate: prove source/dependency, weak form, boundary/constraint, quadrature, space, and direct-route compatibility before A2; A1 or variable-p evidence cannot satisfy this gate

normal_correction_policy.endpoint_state_for_qr_comparison: after the configured normal-correction strategy and before the extra diagnostic correction

A2_Y6_1.extra_same_lu_gate: each new A2 endpoint needs its own one-correction live-factor output-uncertainty check; if unavailable, endpoint is unqualified

B_R9_parent.required_pair_identity: new candidate uses the same R9 variable-p parent route, q/R, source/plan lineage and physical problem except the frozen h action
B_R9_parent.reference_core_gate: B is locked unless evidence covers the same numerical core across R9 parent, h candidate, and comparison reference; current evidence does not establish R9 variable-p and Y6_1 native-P6 core equivalence

C_uniform_p6_reference.novelty_search_scope: Task40 axis catalog contained Y6_1/Y6_2 at 6x16x6; no exact 9x16x6 appeared in currently revealed Task43 list; repeat full launch-list/archive preflight before execution
C_uniform_p6_reference.own_qr_qualification: not established by this one attempt; do not borrow A2 qualification; only finite comparison unless independent same-C q/R evidence exists
C_uniform_p6_reference.comparison_to_B: B is frozen q15/q28/R13; if both run, C minus B mixes space, q, and R effects and is not a pure spatial estimate

B.test: one-level h child from frozen R9 global cell 8
B.comparison_with_Y6_1: cross-discretization/route finite vector only; no claim of native-P6 equivalence or transfer of R10 qualification

C.reference_witness_role: new h-rich independent mesh observation; not selected from B outcome
enabled_only_if: archive novelty preflight passes within stated search scope
measured FE matches or explains predicted 570240
MUMPS structural resource forecast is conservatively within live planning cap
no hard residual or resource stop
C.own_qr_gate: not_run; C alone does not establish it
C.not_run_if: B remains locked, fails, stops, or produces no usable frozen candidate; do not run C as a standalone reference solve

output_perturbation_limits.R14_tail_amplitude_denominator: fixed unit incident-modal floor 1; R13 has no tail rows and no tail amplitude difference is fabricated
output_perturbation_limits.A_volume_provenance: independent material-volume integral; old arithmetic-only replay must be labeled as such

hard_solver_gates.normal_correction_recalculated_from_raw: require finite nonnegative initial/corrected explicit residual norms and rhs-relative values, strict decrease in both, solution_updated=true, and positive correction KSP converged reason; status label alone is insufficient; explicit/A6/condensed gate ratios must also be nonnegative

extra_same_lu_uncertainty.primary_qr_endpoint_state: after each endpoint's configured solver-normal-correction policy and before the extra diagnostic correction; the extra output never replaces or selects the primary q/R endpoint

normal_correction_policy.A2: preserve native Task40 max_same_factor_corrections=2: initial solve plus at most two normal corrections (three total solves); historical Y6_1 actually used one correction

extra_same_lu_uncertainty.failed_gate: preserve actual diagnostic; endpoint unqualified; no repeat correction

canonical_vertical_sidewalls.meaning: four vertical material faces x=16.5/33.5 nm and y=15/35 nm; one-sided mathematical full complex E/H traces from both Si and air material-side cells at zero offset

resource_policy.reserve_policy: max(64 GiB, 15% of effective total memory)
resource_policy.launch_cap_policy: min(192 GiB, 80% effective total, effective available minus reserve)
resource_policy.planning_cap_policy: min(192 GiB, 75% effective total, launch cap)
resource_policy.global_swap: observe only; not attributed to this task
resource_policy.cpu: one actually available CPU, recorded per launch

wall_basis.C_scale_note: 570240 predicted FE is 1.50x Y6_1 (380160 FE) and 4.80x R10; no matching full-watchdog calibration exists, so C additionally requires conservative rows/NNZ/MUMPS forecast below the actual dynamic planning cap

stopping.hard_residual_or_resource_failure: stop affected branch, preserve failure, no automatic retry
stopping.A_qR_perturbation_over_10_percent: if hard gates pass and baseline is trustworthy, complete remaining predeclared A factor then lock B/C
stopping.extra_same_lu_output_uncertainty_failure: if hard gates pass, continue the remaining predeclared R factor for that A branch; preserve uncertainty failure and lock B/C
stopping.A2_core_or_live_factor_uncertainty_gate_: A2 endpoint unqualified; do not substitute another core
stopping.B_seed_or_FE_or_same_parent_identity_fai: do not start B; no alternate seed
stopping.C_novelty_or_resource_forecast_failure: do not start C; no alternate mesh
stopping.C_own_qr_missing: finite full-vector comparison only; no independent precision claim
stopping.C_without_usable_frozen_B_candidate: not_run; do not solve C independently
